custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer's live transparency API attributes each reserve asset to three custody venues; at the 2026-07-17 snapshot roughly 95.4% sat in Falcon-labelled multisig wallets, 2.6% at Ceffu, and 2.1% at Fireblocks (venue shares shift over time). Falcon states that Fireblocks and Ceffu provide MPC custody and off-exchange settlement, but the reviewed sources do not establish account-level segregation, insolvency treatment, or signer structure, and reserve assets are actively deployed into trading and yield strategies, so reuse is inherent to the strategy.
